summary: Authenticates private host-package downloads during reusable source-image validation.
userImpact: Enterprise consumers can run the shared source-image CI gate without an unauthorized package download failure.

notes: This CI-only fix does not change application schemas, migrations, TypeORM behavior, or supported database adapters.

security: The reusable workflow passes its existing least-privilege package token only to the Docker dependency-install build argument.
documentation: The generated technical release notes describe the repaired reusable CI authentication contract.
rollback: Revert the workflow change to restore the previous behavior; no application or database rollback is required.
validation: The workspace runtime contract requires the reusable source-image build to pass its package token.
CI contract tests and workflow lint validate the reusable workflow.
